Allocation history

Recorded on each successful live collection. Percentages measure resource allocation, not hardware activity. Hover near a sample to see recorded percentages; use arrow keys when the chart is focused. Curves smoothly connect samples; ranges longer than seven days use a rolling average to reduce visual noise. Hover values remain the original recorded samples. Average summaries below each plot show the mean of available samples in the selected period. History and capacity cards remain cluster-wide.
